item.text:
<linkedin_post>OpenAI’s partnership with Thrive Holdings reaches beyond supplying AI models. It also sends engineers to work with the holding company’s businesses, which now include home security company ADT.

Thrive acquired ADT for $10 per share, or about $7.6 billion in equity. It plans to make ADT the foundation of a smart home security business and invest in new products, though it has not said what those products will be.

ADT is expected to maintain its partnerships with Apple and Google as technology companies expand their own home security offerings.</linkedin_post>
